title: Night Orchard / evening and visit
organizingIdea: A illustrated evening field carries identity and visit tasks; the interior becomes a legible menu sheet and practical access document.

facts.name: Night Orchard

menu.description: Seasonal leaves, grilled bread and house dressing

facts.access: Step-free garden entrance in fictional brief; customer verification required

provenance.content: Original fictional Vitris teaching brief and authored copy; operational details, dimensions and offers are invented and must never populate customer inventories.
provenance.media: Original inline SVG illustrations authored for this release; no external photographs, branding or type assets.
provenance.rights: Original Vitris teaching material; factual adaptation required for customer use.

storyboard.mobile: Illustration precedes identity/task block instead of obscuring it. Menu descriptions move under dish/price; access follows the menu.

visualReview.scope: desktop/mobile homepage/interior full-page contact-sheet review; batch comparison
visualReview.assessment: All four full-page views visually inspected in contact sheet. Dark illustrated evening scene gives way to short invitation and practical visit strip; narrow identity and actions follow the scene. Interior cream menu sheet preserves dish/description/price relation, moving descriptions below dish/price on narrow. Access and inquiry remain contextual. Some header overlay text crosses branches, but labels/actions remain legible.
